caption:
Paneer Roll 
30 minute lunch recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 44 | F: 12 | P: 16
Calories: 380 per rolls
Makes 4 rolls

Ingredients
200 grams paneer, cubed
1 tsp ghee + 1 tsp jeera
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 onion, sliced
1 chili, finely chopped
1 tomato, sliced, deseeded
1 capsicum, thinly sliced
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala
salt + pepper to taste
handful of fresh coriander

4 rotis, super thin, i use 80 grams flour for the 4 rotis

1 onion, thinly sliced
1/2 cup white vinegar
sprinkle of salt

Method: 
in a pan, add your jeera, onion and ginger garlic paste and cook till onions are translucent
add in the masalas as mentioned above and tomatoes with a splash of water, allow to cook for 5 minutes ( essential to cook the masalas properly) then add in the capsicum and paneer. allow to cook for a few minutes together and take off the heat
cook your phuka the normal way you would
add the paneer mix, pickled onions and loads of chaat masala 
enjoy :)
